The *Sukkātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 35) is a verse biographical narrative in the *Therīapadāna* section of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. It recounts the meritorious actions in past lives leading to the final rebirth and liberation of the nun Sukkā, a figure also known from the *Sukkātherīgāthā* (Thig 3.6) and mentioned in the Vinaya's *Mahākhandhaka* (Kd 1) [SuttaCentral]. The text has five translations listed in modern languages on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
